teaser: Storm Charles: about thirty agents built a weather face over a data room in a night, every figure sourced, timed and labelled.
core_idea: When Storm Charles led Web Summit to call off its second day, one person steering about thirty Claude Code agents by voice built storm-charles.promptugal.news overnight. A weather face for anyone reads only from a data room of hashed datasets, a timeline, decisions, entities and captured evidence, every line labelled fact, evidence or hypothesis. Labs show the storm many ways, a graph and in-browser SQLite answer questions, models are measured as evals, and a journal records how the site was made, its mistakes and its cost. It is part of PrompTugal.news.
